applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term, audit job number and audit type (final, interim, revision, non-compliant)
Each GL exposure: class code, location/state, basis type (payroll, sales, area, units), estimated and audited basis
Whether Products-Completed Operations applies; limits (each occurrence / aggregate)
Expected premium and direction vs premium shown
Mid-term changes (class added/removed, location or limit change) and dates; keyed by auditor or automation; screenshots
title: GL audit wrong after a mid-term change (owner/partner payroll prorated, exposures split)
symptoms: Owner or partner payroll prorated when a mid-term change has been keyed
GL audit wrong only on policies with mid-term endorsements
cause: A mid-term change splits the period into slices. Fixed annual payroll amounts for owners/partners/officers (per state GL rules - confirm with rating manual) are prorated across slices, or exposures added mid-term are not rated from their own effective date.
diagnosis: Identify the slices and exposure effective dates
Compare per-slice basis for fixed-amount payroll and mid-term exposures
resolution: Revised audit with each exposure keyed on its own dates; fixed owner/partner payroll keyed once for the term
workaround: Manual adjustment approved by Premium Audit.
permanent_fix: Rule: fixed-amount payroll is not prorated across slices; mid-term exposures rated from their own effective date.
